juntar-pdf.descricao_pagina: Merge several PDFs into one, in the order you choose. The files are read in your browser and never leave your device.
juntar-pdf.resumo: Pick the files, put them in the right order and download a single PDF. Everything happens in your browser: no file is sent to a server.

enviar.texto: Or pick the files from your device. The order of the list is the order of the final document.
enviar.limite: On Free, up to {limite_lote_gratis} files at a time. Each file can be up to 100 MB.

vazio.texto: Pick at least two PDFs to start.

plus.texto: On Free the batch goes up to {limite} files. Plus unlocks 100 at a time.

erros.arquivo_nao_pdf: "{nome}" is not really a PDF — the file content does not match.
erros.pdf_protegido: "{nome}" is password protected. Open it and save it without a password before merging.
erros.pdf_corrompido: I could not read "{nome}". The file looks damaged.
erros.limite_de_arquivos: Your plan allows merging up to {limite} files at a time.

como_usar.um: Pick or drop the PDFs. They are read **in your browser**, with no upload to a server.
como_usar.dois: Drag them in the list, or use the arrows, to set the order the final document should have.
como_usar.tres: Click merge and download the file. The originals stay untouched on your device.

envio.pergunta: Are my files sent to any server?
envio.resposta: No. The merge uses a library that runs inside the page. If you turn off the internet after opening the tool, it keeps working.

senha.pergunta: What if the PDF has a password?
senha.resposta: A protected PDF cannot be merged without the password. Open the file in your PDF reader, save an unprotected copy and use that copy here.

lote.pergunta: Why does Free limit the quantity?
lote.resposta: The big batch is the Plus feature. The limit is checked on the server: the code that unlocks 100 files is only delivered to whoever has Plus. Since the processing happens in your browser, anyone who edits the code themselves can get around it — we say it plainly, without pretending.
